## About
Mile High Truck And Trailer Repair works on semi trucks and trailers for drivers and fleet owners. Our shop is on E 96th Ave in Henderson, just outside Denver.
We handle breakdown repairs, engine work, suspension and chassis, DEF systems, computer diagnostics, oil changes and complete trailer repair. We're open Monday through Saturday and closed Sunday.
Drivers have rated us 4.8 from 25 Google reviews. Give us a call and tell us what's going on with your truck.

## Services
- Breakdown repairs: Quick diagnostics and on-the-spot repairs for electrical issues, fuel system problems and other breakdowns.
- Engine repairs and overhauls: Everything from minor fixes to full engine rebuilds.
- Suspension and chassis repairs: Shocks, bushings, axles and other critical components, so your truck handles well under heavy loads.
- DEF system repairs: DEF filter replacements, pump and injector repairs, and system diagnostics to help your truck meet emissions standards.
- Trailer repairs: Brakes, lights, axles, suspension and bodywork to keep your trailer roadworthy.
- Computer diagnostics: Diagnostic software and equipment to find problems in the engine, transmission, electrical and aftertreatment systems.
- Oil changes: Fast, efficient oil changes with high-quality oils and filters.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, the same as weekdays. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you work on trailers too?
A: Yes. We do complete trailer repair, including brakes, lights, axles, suspension and bodywork.

Q: Can you come to my truck?
A: We offer mobile service and on-the-spot repairs. Call us, tell us where you are and what's happening, and we'll let you know how we can help.
